CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tying processing/attention to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), organization (origin/representation metadata) and status are each explicitly present but not bound to the same attribute name (e.g. 'red' vs 'origin'), so a single compatible C+O+D binding is ambiguous.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation claim linking attention or processing condition to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple entries identify specific content (colour-labelled cell sets) and their coordinates; the red coordinate for p0/current/n0 is an explicit example.

D.rationale: The report separately lists the content (colour/coordinates) and metadata about that content's origin/representation, distinguishing identity from status/ provenance.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: Text states how contents are represented/presented (origin/representation metadata and a declared list of current/conditional candidate peaks), so organization/presentation/access is explicitly described.
